cover_letter:
Hi Infobip team!

I was thrilled to come across the Senior Partnership Enablement Specialist opening. Infobip is a global leader in cloud communication platforms, and acting as the strategic bridge between Product innovations and partner ecosystems directly matches what I have built my career on over the past 8+ years.

At Wipro (Meta Project), I served as the primary liaison between global product updates and regional commercial teams. I translated complex product developments into high-impact use cases, commercial playbooks, and structured enablement sessions that drove daily adoption up by +150% (ranking our operation #1 globally in growth) and cut consultant ramp-up time by 50% with 90%+ audit quality scores.

Furthermore, I bring practical experience in B2B partnership outreach, CRM automation, and Power BI telemetry to track partner success. Based in Curitiba, Brazil, with fluent English for daily international collaboration, I am fully available for the hybrid model.

I would love to connect and discuss how I can contribute to accelerating the adoption and growth of Infobip's partner ecosystem!

Best regards,
Kevin Augusto Vieira

form_answers.question: How do you translate technical updates into partner value?
form_answers.answer: I start with the business objective, audience, problem, and expected outcome. On the Meta Project, I absorbed official materials and converted product updates into value propositions, pitches, scripts, playbooks, and training for 150+ professionals. I validate clarity through call feedback, adoption metrics, and root cause analysis.

form_answers.question: Tell us about an enablement program you led.
form_answers.answer: I designed and governed the Next Level Bootcamp for 12 consultants, structuring its roadmap, backlog, materials, quality criteria, and follow-up. It achieved 100% completion, 90%+ quality, and reduced ramp-up from 6 to 3 months.

form_answers.question: What is your experience with partners and ecosystems?
form_answers.answer: I have direct experience in B2B outreach, negotiation, and partnership validation at Meu Barzin, plus cross-functional collaboration across product, quality, and global operations at Wipro. I do not claim formal, ongoing ownership of a regional partner ecosystem; that would be a natural extension of my transferable experience.

form_answers.question: What is your CPaaS experience?
form_answers.answer: I do not have documented direct professional CPaaS experience. My transferable foundation includes digital-product enablement, release communication, APIs and webhooks in automation, use cases, CRM, and adoption. I would build domain depth through structured training and close partnership with product and technical specialists.
